outputs.DIFFICULTY_EXPLANATION: StoneVault couples a Rust command/session boundary to a C++20 persistent storage core and requires non-local reasoning across process writer fencing, transaction-lifetime MVCC, conflict arbitration, binary WAL/snapshot recovery, checkpoint publication, operator state and compatibility across crashes and restarts.
outputs.SOLUTION_EXPLANATION: The reference completion restores writer exclusion, stable snapshot visibility with transaction-local overlays, first-committer-wins conflict handling, durable contiguous sequencing, corruption-aware recovery, atomic checkpoint/snapshot publication, correct health/stats and protocol-boundary behavior while preserving the documented native ABI and on-disk formats.
outputs.VERIFICATION_EXPLANATION: The verifier contains 30 change-required probes and 33 preservation probes spanning locking, configuration, MVCC/scan overlay, conflicts, WAL recovery, checkpoint/snapshot integrity, operator state, protocol bounds and native compatibility. The known committed-DELETE restart coverage gap remains explicitly outside claimed coverage and tracked under backlog #66; final runtime/oracle success is owned by DETERMINISTIC_VALIDATION.
